answer: Operator liability escrow. Each agent identity is tied to an operator account that must maintain a fixed 50-unit escrow per active identity. If any linked identity is proven fraudulent, the operator’s whole escrow is slashed and all its identities freeze; the wallet pays nothing. A crystal log records operator links for audits. New identities wait through a lagoon delay. Repeat fraud raises the operator’s canyon reserve multiple, so sybils cost the operator 50 units each plus shared loss.
